notes: SPIN / madewithspin.com (Shopify). Access: direct HTTP (curl_cffi) for collections.json/products.json/sitemap, Playwright/CDP to confirm rendering of the two ambiguous landing-style URLs (bestsellers, bestsellers-1) and the homepage filter-pill widget; Claude-in-Chrome not needed. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow. Discovery: checked mobile-nav drawer (no Bestsellers link), desktop header (a horizontal 'swiper-slide' filter-pill row on the homepage includes an 'All / Stock Sale / Curated Sets / Bestsellers / Living / Dining / ...' tab that AJAX-swaps a small teaser carousel in place - not a real PLP), footer (no match), collections.json (236 collections, full list in one page, no pagination needed), and collections sitemap (confirms all handles below are indexed/live). collections.json's own products_count is inflated on every handle here vs an exhaustive /products.json?limit=250 (paginated) enumeration - trusted the exhaustive enumeration per project convention, and it matches the on-page 'product-facet__meta-bar-item--count' banner text exactly on every included row. Checked for overlap/subset relationships among all best*-handled collections: none is a subset of another (e.g. best-seller-stool-ottoman has 0 overlap with best-sellers), so these are independently-curated sibling listings of the same Bestsellers concept, not a formal nested parent/children taxonomy - emitted as flat sibling rows, no is_group used since no page actually presents them together as a grouped hierarchy. EXCLUDED: /collections/bestsellers (98 products in products.json, title 'Bestsellers') and /collections/bestsellers-1 (695 products, title 'Bestsellers', i.e. ~98% of the site's ~707-product catalog - not a genuine bestseller curation) - both fail criterion 1 (no real grid): direct HTTP and Playwright (incl. scroll + 6s wait) show these two URLs render the SAME content as the homepage/index template (identical 'Curated Sets' and category carousels, identical header filter-pills) with zero dedicated product-grid markup for the collection itself. The live site's only user-facing 'Bestsellers' experience is a homepage filter-pill that swaps in a small teaser carousel (confirmed 8-10 products visible, e.g. Wing Armchair, Arc Sofa, Step Lounger) - not a deep/paginated listing, so not recorded as its own PLP row; its closest published, fully-functioning equivalent is the 'Best Sellers' collection below. SPIN is a furniture+home-accessories brand; unlike the separate Home-Decor/Furniture project, this merchandising-PLP project does not category-restrict to decor, so furniture-type bestseller sub-listings (stool/ottoman, bar, consoles, shelves) are included.
